## New Multiblock

**Power Transformer [PT]**

An alternative active transformer that can be expanded up to 4 layers for more inputs, or rather, outputs, whatever you like the most.

## General changes (Multiblocks)

All multiblocks were significantly changed for the sake of balance for Gregtech core gameplay aspects.

1. **Robust Alloy Materializer**
   - Lost parallel hatches in exchange of Perfect Overclock and Batch Mode
   - Definitive removal of laser hatches usage as they are really broken for what an ABS multiblock can do
   - Changed controller overlay

2. **Synthesis Vessel**
   - No longer performs LCR recipes, only performs its own recipe type
   - Lost machine parallels in exchange of Perfect Overclock and Batch Mode

3. **Large Pyrolysis Oven & Large Cracking Machine**
   - Changed controller textures

4. **Compact Assembly Line**
   - Renamed to Expanded Assembly Line **[EAL]**
   - Lost machine parallels in exchange of Imperfect Subtick Parallels and Batch Mode
   - Entire structure has been reworked, now has layers for each input, implies that it needs a common setup for normal Assembly Lines automation (whether it is AE2 or anything else)
   - Only allows 1 energy hatch, 1 Wireless Optical Receptor, 1 Maintenance Hatch
   - Its logic now allows recipes without ordered inputs, but they still need a new layer per new input (according to recipe size) _(I hope that's clear enough?)_

5. **Rock Processing Factory**
   - Structure modified (again)
   - Allows parallel hatches and has Batch Mode

6. **Industrial Greenhouse & Tree Growing Chamber**
   - (Both) Slight changes on the first layers of their structure
   - (IG) Lost machine parallels in exchange of Perfect Overclock and Batch Mode
   - (TGC) Renamed to Artificial Conservatory **[AC]**

7. **Disassembler**
   - Renamed to Universal Disassembly Machine **[UDM]**
   - Added a new recipe mode:
     - *Component Disassembly* → Recipes for decomposing expensive components like Fusion Reactor casings and Fusion Coils (at the moment I write this)
   - Structure has been entirely reworked

8. **Large Gas Collector**
   - New controller recipe, inlines/fits with the majority of GTCEu IV multis recipes
   - Changed controller overlay
   - Structure has been changed to remove rotor requirement

9. **Matrix Data Relay**
   - From now on, requires a constant supply of 144 mb/t of PCB Coolant WHILE working
   - *Jade Provider:* now shows the tier of the respective wireless transmissor placed inside the structure
   - Expanded Data Hatches have an energy usage of 8196 EU/t (1A IV)
   - Each wireless receptor has an energy consumption of 1 full amp of the next tier:
     - LuV Transmissor → 1A ZPM
     - ZPM Transmissor → 1A UV
     - UV Transmissor → 1A UHV
   - Slightly different color on overlay
   - Internal logic fix: controller not switching back to "unformed" state when a part of the structure is removed

10. Some abbreviations were changed to be less "wacky" _(is this the right word?)_

## General changes (Singleblocks)

1. **Wireless Optical Hatches (Transmissors only)**
   - They now have a small toggle for custom linking behavior, whether they can connect only to Data Hatches / Expanded Data Hatches inside an MDR multiblock, or any nearby DH / EDH inside its maximum range
   - The range display has been modified to reflect an "Abstract" style with irregular triangles and a small "white bar" that goes up and down inside the render
   - Now they have a custom UI **(using Minecraft Screen, without LDLib/ModularUI)** for management of their functions, such as showing the range display and linked hatches, plus a cooldown for any new re-scan (3s)
